_about: Voiceover scripts for the showcase videos. build_showcase.py turns each line into a voice clip plus word timings, then writes public/showcase/<video>.json for Remotion.

scenes.vo: Ten minutes of footage. Four hours of editing. That used to be normal.
Then A.I. video editing changed the math.
It reads your transcript, finds the pauses, the filler words and the retakes, and cuts them in seconds.
While you watch, it tightens the pacing, cleans up the audio, and adds captions.
Captions come in any style. Loud for TikTok, clean for YouTube, elegant for brands.
The workflow is simple. Upload your footage, describe the edit in plain words, then review.
Motion graphics land right on your footage. Name titles, callouts, and your handle.
It even helps you plan what to film, and when to post it.
So what changes?
Tighter edits tend to hold attention longer.
Most editing time goes to repetitive work. Exactly what A.I. is good at.
And every step adds up.
Because the best edit is the one nobody notices.
Now, make it yours.
Pick a design style and every graphic follows it. Clean, dark, editorial, playful, and more.
Titles can glow, or they can whisper.
Upload. Describe the edit. Post in minutes.
Ready? Three. Two. One.
Video Studio. Built for creators.
Thanks for watching. Subscribe for more.
One video. Eight caption styles. Watch.
This one stacks every line, and lights up the active one.
This one stays out of the way, like a movie.
This one pops, word by word, comic style.
This one feels expensive. Gold serif on a dark band.
This one is built for tech. Uppercase, with a neon highlight.
This one is for product launches. Bright and confident.
And this one reads like a magazine.
Thirty two styles. One line of code to switch.
Clean SaaS. White space, soft cards, one bright accent.
Dark tech. Near black, with glowing cyan.
Editorial. Serif headlines and warm paper.
Playful pop. Chunky type and candy colours.
Corporate trust. Navy, calm, and clear.
Warm story. A documentary feel.
Bold creator. Huge type, loud yellow.
And edu chalk, for teaching.
